experiment_data.notes:
Iso-compute BCE: 2700 步匹配 KL 1000 步的总 FLOPs (ratio=2.71x, 实测 profile_flops.py: KL 0.549s/step vs BCE 0.202s/step @BS=1,SL=512)。
Reviewer Concern #2 defense: 验证 KL 优势来自 loss 函数本身而非计算量差异。

## FLOPs 计算依据
- KL 每步: dense fwd (no grad) + sparse fwd (grad) + backward w/ gradient checkpointing = 0.549s
- BCE 每步: dense fwd (no grad) + predictor fwd/bwd (~0.9% model FLOPs) = 0.202s
- Ratio: 2.71x → 1000 KL steps ≈ 2700 BCE steps

## 监控
- Step 200: sparsity=0.566 (与 bce_comp_staged_s42 同模式, model_level_sparsity 待 eval 确认)
- Director 要求: step 1000 时 sparsity >0.55 需汇报, 可能需规划 sparsity-matched ablation
